exec: pm.test("Pendiente propio y aislamiento", () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows.some(x => x.id === Number(pm.environment.get("prestamo_id")) && x.estado === "PRESTADO")).to.eql(true); pm.expect(rows.every(x => x.lector_id === Number(pm.environment.get("lector_id")))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(rows.some(x => x.id === Number(pm.environment.get("prestamo_otro_id")))).to.eql(false); });

pm.test("Vence hoy y aislamiento", () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows.some(x => x.id === Number(pm.environment.get("prestamo_id")) && x.tipo_alerta === "VENCE_HOY")).to.eql(true); pm.expect(rows.every(x => x.lector_id === Number(pm.environment.get("lector_id")))).to.eql(true); });

exec: pm.test("Historial devuelto", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(x => x.id === Number(pm.environment.get("prestamo_id")) && x.estado === "DEVUELTO")).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Devuelto excluido de alertas", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(x => x.id === Number(pm.environment.get("prestamo_id")))).to.eql(false); });
